description: TEER (Training, Education, Experience and Responsibilities) category definitions for NOC 2021.

teer_levels.label: Management occupations
teer_levels.description: Management occupations across all industries and sectors.
teer_levels.ee_cec_note: Management experience may qualify for CEC if TEER 0-3 in Canada.

teer_levels.label: Occupations usually requiring a university degree
teer_levels.description: Completion of a university degree (bachelor's, master's or doctorate) or several years of experience in a related occupation from TEER 2.

teer_levels.label: Occupations usually requiring college diploma or apprenticeship
teer_levels.description: Completion of a post-secondary education program of two to three years at community college, CEGEP, or apprenticeship training of two to five years; or occupations with supervisory or significant safety responsibilities.

teer_levels.label: Occupations usually requiring college, apprenticeship or >6 months training
teer_levels.description: Completion of post-secondary program of less than two years, apprenticeship less than two years, or more than six months of on-the-job training.

teer_levels.label: Occupations usually requiring secondary school and/or occupation-specific training
teer_levels.description: Completion of secondary school, or several weeks of on-the-job training with some secondary school education.
teer_levels.note: Not eligible for FSW; may qualify for some PNPs or pilot programs.

teer_levels.label: Occupations usually requiring short-term work demonstration
teer_levels.description: Short work demonstration and no formal educational requirements.
teer_levels.note: Not eligible for FSW Express Entry.
